_comment: Router profile table. alpha bands are FITTED by src/fit_bands.py from measured acceptance rates; alpha_n says how many back each one. temp_measured_ceiling is the highest temperature at which an objective validator still passed every run in src/run_temp_quality.py — a FAILURE BOUNDARY, not an optimum. It bounds where output breaks; it does not say which temperature is best, because no quality judge exists here. mtp_enabled is backed by the depth-1 on/off A/B; recommended_depth by the depth sweep. temp_validator_version records which validator measured each ceiling; current is 2026-10-02.audit1. `python3 src/check_router_staleness.py` flags any ceiling derived under a different one.

code_repetitive.label: 模板化 / 重复结构代码
code_repetitive.why: 实测开/关差 +23.6%，是全部任务里最赚的一个；α>90% 时 depth 2 还能再赚 6-18%。
code_repetitive.temp_evidence: T3 Shape: content valid 5/5 at every temperature through 1.5.

code_function.label: 单函数 / 脚本实现
code_function.why: 实测开/关差 +15.4%。α 高但单任务样本，depth 1 已足够。
code_function.alpha_note: n=1 < 3 — using the default band, not the data
code_function.temp_evidence: T2 LRU cache: content valid 5/5 at every temperature through 1.5. Caveat: the eviction logic itself is NOT measured - see AUDIT_CHECKLIST.

structured_json.label: 结构化输出 (JSON / 表格 / schema)
structured_json.why: 语法约束强，α 高且温度几乎不影响它。低温保格式。
structured_json.alpha_note: n=1 < 3 — using the default band, not the data
structured_json.temp_evidence: T1 JSON: content valid 4/5 at T=0.3, 5/5 across T=0.6-1.2, 4/5 at 1.5. The residual failure is an unclosed array, not temperature-driven damage.
structured_json.why_temp: raised from 0.1 to 0.3: validity held at 100% through T=0.9, so 0.1 was needlessly rigid. Not raised further — the sweep bounded the failure point, it did not find an optimum.

extraction.label: 抽取 / 总结 / 改写
extraction.why: α 在 78-90% 中间带，depth 1 稳，depth 2 收益在噪声内。
extraction.alpha_note: n=1 < 3 — using the default band, not the data

math_reasoning.label: 数学 / 证明 / 推导
math_reasoning.why: T=1.6 端实测 −10.4pt，中低温更稳。
math_reasoning.alpha_note: n=2 < 3 — using the default band, not the data
math_reasoning.temp_evidence: T7 arithmetic: 5/5 through T=1.2, 4/5 at 1.5 where the one failure hit the token cap before answering the reordering question.

qa_factual.label: 事实问答 / 解释 / 对比
qa_factual.why: 实测开/关 −2.6%，落在 ±4.5% 噪声内 —— 开着不亏也不用指望它赚。
qa_factual.temp_evidence: T6 TCP explainer: 5/5 only at T<=0.6. From T=0.3 upward it intermittently drops the 'why not four handshakes' point (2/5, 0/5, 2/5, 1/5, 2/5 at 0.3/0.6/0.9/1.2/1.5). Coverage of a stated requirement is the thing that breaks first, not correctness of the explanation.
qa_factual.why_temp: lowered from 0.5 to 0.4: the TCP explainer stopped covering all three required points above T=0.6. n=5 per cell, so this is a soft ceiling.

translation.label: 翻译
translation.why: 实测 T=0→1.6 掉 −12.7pt，是掉得最狠的任务，用词自由度大。
translation.alpha_note: n=1 < 3 — using the default band, not the data

creative.label: 创意写作 / 散文 / 头脑风暴
creative.why: 实测开 MTP 反而慢 14.6% —— 全部任务里最差。α<60% 时关掉比调任何 depth 都划算。
creative.alpha_note: n=1 < 3 — using the default band, not the data
creative.temp_evidence: T8 checked length and simile count only — that is the prompt's own requirement, not a quality judgement

general.label: 通用 / 混合对话
general.why: 真实 coding-agent 对话轮的 α 就落在这个带里（65-83%），depth 1 赢 14/16（p=0.0021）。

depth_advice._comment: Per-request depth is impossible in oMLX 0.7.0: any settings write triggers a full model reload (~47 s measured). Set it once per session, not per request.

switch_at_sessions_start.if: 整段会话都是模板化代码，且能接受 47 秒重载
整段会话都是纯创意写作
